title: WP-2026-0147: badf-git CLEAN has no measured command for deleting landed local branches
problem:
## Problem

`skills/badf-git/references/git-cycle.md` section 13 (CLEAN) permits deleting only local state that is proven landed, not the only copy, not holding unknown work and not needed for open review. Nothing measures that. Deleting a local branch today means hand-running `git branch -d/-D`. That cannot see squash merges, which are this repository's approved merge method (GIT-I09), so `git branch --merged` reports squash-landed branches as unmerged. It also records no before-state, no recovery ref and no authorising work package.

## Requested outcome

Add a `badf_gate.py git-clean` subcommand, consistent with GIT-I12 (enforcement lives in the canonical control, not a second tool):

- **Dry run by default (GIT-O0).** Classify every local branch against `origin/<default>` as PROTECTED (the default branch or checked out in any worktree), MERGED (ancestor), SQUASHED (net-diff patch-id already on the target) or UNMERGED. Write no ref and no object.
- **`--apply --wp <WP>` (GIT-O1).** Preserve each landed tip at `refs/recovery/<WP>/clean/<branch>` and never overwrite an existing one. Delete with `update-ref -d <ref> <observed sha>`, so a branch that moved is kept (HELD).
- **Out of scope.** No fetch, no push, no remote branch deletion (GIT-O3).

Authorised by the operator in a Claude Code session on 2026-09-27.
